items.title: Danny Barker Interview, 1976-02-04
items.q: He tried to get Kid Rene. Younger trumpet players to come and play the second.

ctx.x: some people have indicated that he really wanted Louis to stay with him in Chicago when Louis left and went to New York, and that I think Lil Armstrong, his wife, his second wife, sort of had an influence on his leaving the band. Do you think there was any bitterness on Joe's part when Louis left to go to Chicago?

Oh, that's not no bitterness. I don't think there was no, there was no bitterness, but it was a sort of a, a loss to Joe because there was a tradition in New Orleans to have two trumpets in the band. Papa Celestine had two, at one time, Manny Perez had two, first and second trumpet. And, uh, other bands around had two trumpets, and you played second. And it was guys, it's just like baseball, a second string catcher, you dig, more than one pitcher, and, uh, or more than one quarterback in a, a football team. It…

items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That’s where you heard them bands. That’s why kids could advance, because they could hear Kid Rena in the daytime.

ctx.x: That’s right. See King Oliver. In those days we’d have maybe six or seven guys following right within hearing distance, not to disrupt the second line, to listen to King Oliver blow, wait until he play his chorus, and he’d blow it at them. “Hey Joe, put that riff in there.” Him and Kid Rena, he had his followers, and Buddy Petit had more followers than anybody.

items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: My little uncle, Willie, would whisper [SOTTO VOCE] ... 'That's Kid Rena.' ... At that time, when I was coming up, when I was kid around 10 and 11 and 12, you'd see ... Kid Rena's band.

ctx.x: He had a society type band, didn't he.

Yes. And that was... You looked up on him; you saw him in the street. And these people were all celebrated when you'd see as a kid. My little uncle, Willie, would whisper [SOTTO VOCE] "That's Mister Manuel Perez. That's Mister Buddy Petit. That's Kid Rena. That's Chris Kelly. That's ...(?)...." (?) had this great band, you'd hear him. And I'm listening to all that.
